decision_rationale: The record describes GeneChat as a multi-modal large language model that generates free-form natural language gene function descriptions. It also states the model uses a pretrained DNABERT-2 encoder and an LLM, which supports foundation-model-like transfer and broad applicability.
evidence_snippet: "multi-modal large language model"; "generates a detailed natural language description"; "domain-specific pretrained model optimized for genomic sequences"; "free-form prediction of gene functions"; "a gene encoder, a large language model (LLM), and an adaptor"
